messages:
Maya (PR): Quick sync 1 launch date locked 2027-05-12. Need to finalize press + analyst outreach cadence by EOD Thurs. Embargo target 09:00 PT. Who owns quote approvals?
Ethan (Growth): Ill own routing for press contacts and calendar slots. Need final quote by Tue COB.
Lena (Product): Benchmarks narrative is ready. Shared draft: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-release/benchmarks/runner-v1.md 1 PR, please sanity-check phrasing around cost-per-token vs latency.
Tom (Engineering): We might update throughput numbers after perf run. ETA for final figures: Mon morning.
Maya (PR): @Noah legal, can you sign off on quote language + embargo terms? Also want a 24h fact-check window post-embargo for analysts.
Noah (Legal): Send the quote draft. Legal requests conservative phrasing 1 avoid absolutes like "always" or "zero". Also need a signed fact-check NDA for any pre-embargo deep dives.
Sofia (Sales): For inbound routing: can we add a routing snippet in the press kit for sales handoff? Example: "Lead tier: press -> SDRs for immediate follow, analysts -> AE. Add lead tag: press-2027-launch."
Maya (PR): Adding routing snippet to press kit now. Press kit location: s3://redwood-release/presskit-2027-05-12/ (one-pager, benchmarks, quote templates).
Ethan (Growth): Scheduling note: 20-min analyst walk-throughs preferred. APAC availability tight 1 propose EOD PT and 08:00 APAC slots.
Lena (Product): We'll prepare a condensed demo + two benchmark slides for 20-min slot.
Tom (Engineering): If perf table changes, update CSV in kit: s3://redwood-release/benchmarks/data.csv.
Maya (PR): Draft quote below 1 paste edits inline:
```
"Redwood Inference enables predictable, low-latency LLM serving at scale. In our benchmarks we observed median token latency of ~X ms and cost improvements of ~Y% versus baseline."
```
Maya (PR): Ping @Noah before releasing.
Noah (Legal): Will add boilerplate: "Results may vary by workload and configuration." I will sign off once language is conservative.
Ethan (Growth): Calendar poll: https://doodle.com/poll/launch-analyst-slots 1 vote by Tue noon. Ill lock schedule Wed morning.
press-bot: Calendar invites created for slots confirmed on Wed 10:00 PT and Thu 16:00 CET.
Sofia (Sales): Inbound playbook suggestion: 1) tag & route, 2) send press kit + follow, 3) AE outreach if analyst is MQL. I can draft playbook by Wed.
Lena (Product): Decision needed: include p99 latency in public benchmarks? It fluctuates. If included, add footnote with sequence length and batch settings.
Maya (PR): Include p99 with footnote 1 transparency helps analysts. Add footnote text to kit.
Tom (Engineering): Freezing perf figures Mon 09:00 PT. After freeze I'll push CSV and update S3 paths.
Maya (PR): Timeline summary:
- Mon 09:00 PT: perf freeze (Tom)
- Mon EOD: final quote draft in doc (Maya)
- Tue noon: calendar poll closes (all)
- Wed morning: lock briefing schedule (Ethan)
- Wed EOD: Legal sign-off on quote & boilerplate (Noah)
- Thu: analyst briefings start (confirmed slots)
Please react with :thumbsup: on tasks you own.
Ethan (Growth): :thumbsup: scheduling.
Lena (Product): :thumbsup: slides.
Tom (Engineering): :thumbsup: perf freeze.
Noah (Legal): :thumbsup: will review Mon.
Sofia (Sales): :thumbsup: playbook draft Wed.
Maya (PR): Thanks all 1 ping here if timing or facts change. If embargo time needs shifting, call it out ASAP.
